headline: This law names a Schaumburg, Illinois post office building the Veterans of Iraq and Afghanistan Memorial Post Office Building.
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to a U.S. Postal Service facility at 450 West Schaumburg Road in Schaumburg, Illinois. The building will be called the Veterans of Iraq and Afghanistan Memorial Post Office Building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022.
